entities.summary: The global movement demanding urgent action on climate change, from Rio Earth Summit (1992) through the Paris Agreement (2015) to Greta Thunberg's School Strike for Climate (2018). Combining scientific advocacy, youth activism, policy campaigns, and legal action, the climate movement represents the largest coordinated environmental effort in human history.
